solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
peranakan_museum | Peranakan Museum | 15 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
national_museum | National Museum of Singapore | 15 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
wings_of_time | Wings of Time | 19 | 20 | 19:30-21:30 | 19:40, 20:40
spectra | Spectra Light and Water Show | 0 | 15 | 19:45-21:30 | 20:00, 21:00

cable_car | Singapore Cable Car | 35 | 45 | 08:45-22:00 | -

oceanarium | Singapore Oceanarium | 50 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

Hey, I’ve got some free time between 11:00 and 23:10. My budget is S$24. I’m definitely looking to hit up Maxwell Food Centre and Wings of Time. If I can fit more in, I’d also love to see the Peranakan Museum, National Museum of Singapore, Spectra Light and Water Show, Skyline Luge Sentosa, OCBC Skyway, Night Safari, Singapore Cable Car, Singapore Oceanarium, River Wonders and Singapore Zoo.

import json
from z3 import *

# Create Z3 solver
s = Solver()

# Places data
places = {
    "peranakan_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "national_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "wings_of_time": {"cost": 19, "dur": 20, "open": 1170, "close": 1290, "shows": [1180, 1240]},
    "spectra": {"cost": 0, "dur": 15, "open": 1185, "close": 1290, "shows": [1200, 1260]},
    "skyline_luge": {"cost": 30, "dur": 60, "open": 600, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "ocbc_skyway": {"cost": 14, "dur": 30, "open": 540, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "night_safari": {"cost": 56, "dur": 180, "open": 1155, "close": 1440, "shows": []},

    "maxwell": {"cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 480, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
    "oceanarium": {"cost": 50, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "river_wonders": {"cost": 43, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "singapore_zoo": {"cost": 49, "dur": 240, "open": 510, "close": 1080, "shows": []}
}

travel_times = {
    ("peranakan_museum", "national_museum"): 11, ("peranakan_museum", "wings_of_time"): 25, ("peranakan_museum", "spectra"): 14, ("peranakan_museum", "skyline_luge"): 24, ("peranakan_museum", "ocbc_skyway"): 16, ("peranakan_museum", "night_safari"): 44, ("peranakan_museum", "cable_car"): 21, ("peranakan_museum", "maxwell"): 14, ("peranakan_museum", "oceanarium"): 23, ("peranakan_museum", "river_wonders"): 44, ("peranakan_museum", "singapore_zoo"): 43,
    ("national_museum", "peranakan_museum"): 11, ("national_museum", "wings_of_time"): 25, ("national_museum", "spectra"): 15, ("national_museum", "skyline_luge"): 25, ("national_museum", "ocbc_skyway"): 16, ("national_museum", "night_safari"): 43, ("national_museum", "cable_car"): 21, ("national_museum", "maxwell"): 15, ("national_museum", "oceanarium"): 23, ("national_museum", "river_wonders"): 43, ("national_museum", "singapore_zoo"): 43,
    ("wings_of_time", "peranakan_museum"): 25, ("wings_of_time", "national_museum"): 25, ("wings_of_time", "spectra"): 25, ("wings_of_time", "skyline_luge"): 11, ("wings_of_time", "ocbc_skyway"): 25, ("wings_of_time", "night_safari"): 52, ("wings_of_time", "cable_car"): 16, ("wings_of_time", "maxwell"): 21, ("wings_of_time", "oceanarium"): 13, ("wings_of_time", "river_wonders"): 52, ("wings_of_time", "singapore_zoo"): 52,
    ("spectra", "peranakan_museum"): 14, ("spectra", "national_museum"): 15, ("spectra", "wings_of_time"): 25, ("spectra", "skyline_luge"): 24, ("spectra", "ocbc_skyway"): 12, ("spectra", "night_safari"): 47, ("spectra", "cable_car"): 22, ("spectra", "maxwell"): 14, ("spectra", "oceanarium"): 23, ("spectra", "river_wonders"): 47, ("spectra", "singapore_zoo"): 47,
    ("skyline_luge", "peranakan_museum"): 24, ("skyline_luge", "national_museum"): 25, ("skyline_luge", "wings_of_time"): 11, ("skyline_luge", "spectra"): 24, ("skyline_luge", "ocbc_skyway"): 25, ("skyline_luge", "night_safari"): 51, ("skyline_luge", "cable_car"): 16, ("skyline_luge", "maxwell"): 21, ("skyline_luge", "oceanarium"): 12, ("skyline_luge", "river_wonders"): 52, ("skyline_luge", "singapore_zoo"): 52,
    ("ocbc_skyway", "peranakan_museum"): 16, ("ocbc_skyway", "national_museum"): 16, ("ocbc_skyway", "wings_of_time"): 25, ("ocbc_skyway", "spectra"): 12, ("ocbc_skyway", "skyline_luge"): 25, ("ocbc_skyway", "night_safari"): 48, ("ocbc_skyway", "cable_car"): 23, ("ocbc_skyway", "maxwell"): 16, ("ocbc_skyway", "oceanarium"): 24, ("ocbc_skyway", "river_wonders"): 48, ("ocbc_skyway", "singapore_zoo"): 48,
    ("night_safari", "peranakan_museum"): 44, ("night_safari", "national_museum"): 43, ("night_safari", "wings_of_time"): 52, ("night_safari", "spectra"): 47, ("night_safari", "skyline_luge"): 51, ("night_safari", "ocbc_skyway"): 48, ("night_safari", "cable_car"): 46, ("night_safari", "maxwell"): 46, ("night_safari", "oceanarium"): 50, ("night_safari", "river_wonders"): 11, ("night_safari", "singapore_zoo"): 12,
    ("cable_car", "peranakan_museum"): 21, ("cable_car", "national_museum"): 21, ("cable_car", "wings_of_time"): 16, ("cable_car", "spectra"): 22, ("cable_car", "skyline_luge"): 16, ("cable_car", "ocbc_skyway"): 23, ("cable_car", "night_safari"): 46, ("cable_car", "maxwell"): 18, ("cable_car", "oceanarium"): 14, ("cable_car", "river_wonders"): 47, ("cable_car", "singapore_zoo"): 47,
    ("maxwell", "peranakan_museum"): 14, ("maxwell", "national_museum"): 15, ("maxwell", "wings_of_time"): 21, ("maxwell", "spectra"): 14, ("maxwell", "skyline_luge"): 21, ("maxwell", "ocbc_skyway"): 16, ("maxwell", "night_safari"): 46, ("maxwell", "cable_car"): 18, ("maxwell", "oceanarium"): 19, ("maxwell", "river_wonders"): 47, ("maxwell", "singapore_zoo"): 46,

    ("river_wonders", "peranakan_museum"): 44, ("river_wonders", "national_museum"): 43, ("river_wonders", "wings_of_time"): 52, ("river_wonders", "spectra"): 47, ("river_wonders", "skyline_luge"): 52, ("river_wonders", "ocbc_skyway"): 48, ("river_wonders", "night_safari"): 11, ("river_wonders", "cable_car"): 47, ("river_wonders", "maxwell"): 47, ("river_wonders", "oceanarium"): 50, ("river_wonders", "singapore_zoo"): 11,
    ("singapore_zoo", "peranakan_museum"): 43, ("singapore_zoo", "national_museum"): 43, ("singapore_zoo", "wings_of_time"): 52, ("singapore_zoo", "spectra"): 47, ("singapore_zoo", "skyline_luge"): 52, ("singapore_zoo", "ocbc_skyway"): 48, ("singapore_zoo", "night_safari"): 12, ("singapore_zoo", "cable_car"): 47, ("singapore_zoo", "maxwell"): 46, ("singapore_zoo", "oceanarium"): 50, ("singapore_zoo", "river_wonders"): 11
}

# Time window: 11:00 (660) to 23:10 (1390)
WINDOW_START = 660
WINDOW_END = 1390
BUDGET = 24

must_visit = ["maxwell", "wings_of_time"]

# Variables
visits = {}
for p_id in places:
    visits[p_id] = {
        "is_visited": Bool(f"visit_{p_id}"),
        "start": Int(f"start_{p_id}"),
        "end": Int(f"end_{p_id}")
    }

# Must-visit constraints
for p_id in must_visit:
    s.add(visits[p_id]["is_visited"] == True)

# Budget constraint
cost_expr = Sum([If(visits[p_id]["is_visited"], places[p_id]["cost"], 0) for p_id in places])
s.add(cost_expr <= BUDGET)

# Time bounds and duration constraints
for p_id, data in places.items():
    v = visits[p_id]
    dur = data["dur"]
    
    # Time bounds within overall window
    s.add(v["start"] >= WINDOW_START)
    s.add(v["end"] <= WINDOW_END)
    s.add(v["end"] == v["start"] + dur)
    
    # Opening and closing constraints
    s.add(v["start"] >= data["open"])
    s.add(v["end"] <= data["close"])
    
    # If not visited, start/end can be constrained or ignored, but Z3 handles it well if bounded.
    # If visited, must be within open/close. Handled by implications:
    s.add(Implies(v["is_visited"], And(v["start"] >= data["open"], v["end"] <= data["close"])))

    # Showtimes constraint
    if data["shows"]:
        show_conditions = Or([v["start"] == st for st in data["shows"]])
        s.add(Implies(v["is_visited"], show_conditions))

# Non-overlap and travel time constraints
p_ids = list(places.keys())
for i in range(len(p_ids)):
    for j in range(len(p_ids)):
        if i != j:
        
            p1 = p_ids[i]
            p2 = p_ids[j]
            v1 = visits[p1]
            v2 = visits[p2]
            travel = travel_times[(p1, p2)]
            
            # If both p1 and p2 are visited, either p1 finishes + travel <= p2 start, or p2 finishes + travel <= p1 start
            s.add(Implies(
                And(v1["is_visited"], v2["is_visited"]),
                Or(
                    v1["end"] + travel <= v2["start"],
                    v2["end"] + travel <= v1["start"]
                )
            ))

# Solve
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    result = []
    for p_id in places:
        if is_true(m[visits[p_id]["is_visited"]]):
            start_val = m[visits[p_id]["start"]].as_long()
            end_val = m[visits[p_id]["end"]].as_long()
            result.append({
                "location_id": p_id,
                "start": start_val,
                "end": end_val
            })
    # Sort result by start time
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
